Also consider crediting/critiquing the rep's actual legitimacy answer at 01:04 ('we do work with Pacific Power to set up the system...') which directly responds to the customer's opening suspicion but is currently omitted from the intro-legitimacy analysis in cherry_pick_moments[0].
